question:
*(Continuation of previous question)*
(2) The value of machinery and furniture is to be reduced by 40 %.
(3) ₹ 1000 bad debts reserve on debtors is not required.
(4) ₹ 1500 repairing expense is required for stock.
(6) Outstanding expenses is ₹ 10,000 and income receivable is ₹ 2000.
(7) Investment is to be shown at its market value.
₹ 1500 out of creditors is now not to be paid which is to be recorded in the books.
question_hi:
*(पिछले प्रश्न की निरंतरता)*
(2) मशीनरी और फर्नीचर के मूल्य को 40% तक कम किया जाना है।
(3) देनदारों पर ₹ 1000 डूबत ऋण संचय की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
(4) स्टॉक के लिए ₹ 1500 मरम्मत व्यय की आवश्यकता है।
(6) अदत्त व्यय ₹ 10,000 है और प्राप्य आय ₹ 2000 है।
(7) निवेश को उसके बाजार मूल्य पर दिखाया जाना है।
लेनदारों में से ₹ 1500 का भुगतान अब नहीं किया जाना है, जिसे पुस्तकों में दर्ज किया जाना है।
question_gu:
*(અગાઉના પ્રશ્નનું ચાલુ)*
(2) યંત્રો અને ફર્નિચરની કિંમતમાં 40% ઘટાડો કરવાનો છે.
(3) દેવાદારો પર ₹ 1000 ઘાલખાધ અનામતની જરૂર નથી.
(4) સ્ટોક માટે ₹ 1500 સમારકામ ખર્ચ જરૂરી છે.
(6) ચૂકવવાનો બાકી ખર્ચ ₹ 10,000 છે અને મળવાની બાકી આવક ₹ 2000 છે.
(7) રોકાણોને તેની બજાર કિંમતે દર્શાવવાના છે.
લેણદારોમાંથી ₹ 1500 હવે ચૂકવવાના નથી, જે ચોપડે નોંધવાના છે.
explanation: Provide the journal entries and capital accounts based on these adjustments.
explanation_hi: इन समायोजनों के आधार पर रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ और पूंजी खाते प्रदान करें।
explanation_gu: આ હવાલાઓના આધારે આમનોંધ અને મૂડી ખાતાં આપો.

question:
14. Dattu, Daya and Tarak are the partners of a partnership firm sharing profit-losses in the ratio of 4:3:2. Their firm's balance sheet as on 31-3-2017 is as under :

**Balance sheet as on 31-3-2017 of Dattu, Daya and Tarak's firm**

| Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Capital accounts :** | | **Non-current assets :** | |
| Dattu | 1,00,000 | Land-building | 90,000 |
| Daya | 50,000 | Machinery | 80,000 |
| Tarak | 50,000 | Furniture | 20,000 |
| | 2,00,000 | Investments | 15,000 |
| **Reserves :** | | **Current assets :** | |
| General reserve | 36,000 | Debtors (80,000 - Bad debts 4,000) | 76,000 |
| Workers accident compensation fund | 23,000 | - Bad debts reserve 6,000 | 70,000 |
| **Non-current liabilities :** | | Bills receivable | 5000 |
| 9 % bank loan | 40,000 | Stock | 15,000 |
| **Current-liabilities :** | | Cash balance | 55,000 |
| Creditors | 50,000 | Profit-loss account | 27,000 |
| Bills payable | 20,000 | | |
| Bank overdraft | 8000 | | |
| **Total** | **3,77,000** | **Total** | **3,77,000** |

As on above balance sheet date, partners changed profit-loss sharing ratio to 1:1:1 and the following revaluation account is prepared for the revaluation of assets and liabilities.

**Revaluation Account**
| Dr Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Cr Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| To Machinery A/c | 35,000 | By Land-building A/c | 10,000 |
| To Furniture A/c | 5,000 | By Creditors A/c | 6,000 |
| To Investment A/c | 3,000 | By Income receivables A/c | 3,000 |
| To Bad debts reserve A/c | 10,000 | By Partners’ capital A/c (Loss) : | |
| To Stock A/c | 3,000 | Dattu 18,000 | |
| To Outstanding expenses A/c | 2,000 | Daya 13,500 | |
| To Bank overdraft interest A/c | 1,500 | Tarak 9,000 | 40,500 |
| **Total** | **59,500** | **Total** | **59,500** |

A claim of ₹ 5000 was against workers accident compensation fund.
From the above information write journal entries and prepare partners’ capital account and balance sheet after revaluation.
explanation: Provide the required journal entries, revaluation account, capital accounts, and balance sheet to solve this practice question.
explanation_hi: इस अभ्यास प्रश्न को हल करने के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ, पुनर्मूल्यांकन खाता, पूंजी खाते और पक्का चिट्ठा प्रदान करें।
explanation_gu: આ પ્રેક્ટિસ પ્રશ્ન ઉકેલવા માટે જરૂરી આમનોંધ, પુનઃમૂલ્યાંકન ખાતું, મૂડી ખાતાં અને પાકું સરવૈયું આપો.
